study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective observational cohort study
cohort: 2,353 nulliparous women undergoing induction with nonanomalous fetuses in the cephalic presentation from the Nulliparous Pregnancy Outcomes Study: Monitoring Mothers-to-Be (nuMoM2b) study
finding: PG use for cervical ripening was associated with a higher rate of CD in women carrying SGA neonates compared to those with AGA neonates.
mod_finding: PG use was associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery in SGA neonates.
birth_weight: SGA defined as birth weight <10th percentile for gestational age and sex
